name: Exploding Bolas
description: Throw bolas that deal arcane damage on impact and again when they explode after a short delay.

zh.name: 爆裂流星锤
zh.description: 掷出流星锤，命中时造成奥术伤害，短暂延迟爆炸时再次造成伤害。

subskills.name: Exploding Bolas
subskills.description: Core of the Exploding Bolas subtree.

zh.name: 爆裂流星锤
zh.description: 爆裂流星锤 子树核心。

subskills.name: Explosive Outburst
subskills.description: Increases the explosion area of effect radius of exploding bolas.

zh.name: 爆炸 Outburst
zh.description: 提高 effect radius of 爆裂流星锤 的爆炸范围。

subskills.name: Improved Design
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by exploding bolas.

zh.name: Improved Design
zh.description: 提高造成的伤害爆裂流星锤。

subskills.name: Close Impact
subskills.description: Inflicts arcane break on hit.

zh.name: 近身冲击
zh.description: 命中时施加奥术击破。

subskills.name: Fastbol
subskills.description: Increases projectile speed.

zh.name: Fastbol
zh.description: 提高投射物速度。

subskills.name: Multibolas
subskills.description: Throw multiple bolas in an arc.

zh.name: Multibolas
zh.description: 投掷多个流星锤呈弧线。

subskills.name: Low Blow
subskills.description: Bolas have a chance on hit to stun the enemy.

zh.name: 低 Blow
zh.description: 流星锤有概率命中时至眩晕敌人。

subskills.name: Another One
subskills.description: Chance for bolas to explode an additional time.

zh.name: 另一个一次
zh.description: 概率使流星锤至爆炸额外一次。

subskills.name: Tough Fall
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to stunned targets.

zh.name: Tough Fall
zh.description: 提高对 眩晕目标 造成的伤害。

subskills.name: Speedslinger
subskills.description: Increases cast rate when using exploding bolas.

zh.name: Speedslinger
zh.description: 提高施法速度使用爆裂流星锤。

subskills.name: Longer Ropes
subskills.description: Bolas now pierce allowing them to attach to multiple targets dealing increased damage.

zh.name: 更久 Ropes
zh.description: 流星锤穿透 allowing 它们至 attach 至多个目标造成提高伤害。

subskills.name: Loaded Charge
subskills.description: Bolas are stuck on enemies for a longer period of time, dealing damage to them during this period causes the explosion to gain increased damage & size up to 5 times.

zh.name: Loaded 冲锋
zh.description: 流星锤卡住敌人更久期间之时间，造成伤害至它们 during this 期间使爆炸至获得提高伤害 & size 上至 5 次。

subskills.name: Clusterducks
subskills.description: Throw multiple explosive rubberducks that bounce towards a nearby target before exploding.

zh.name: Clusterducks
zh.description: 投掷多个爆炸 rubberducks 弹射朝向附近目标 before exploding。

subskills.name: Magnetic String
subskills.description: Monsters caught by bolas are pulled towards the first target.

zh.name: Magnetic String
zh.description: 怪物 caught 流星锤牵引朝向第一目标。

subskills.name: Bola'd Stasis
subskills.description: Bola now grabs all enemies on its path and pulls nearby enemies towards it when hitting terrain.

zh.name: Bola'd 停滞
zh.description: Bola grabs 全部敌人路径上的与牵引附近敌人朝向当命中地形。

name: Fan of Knives
description: Attacks have a chance to throw knives around you dealing physical damage to nearby monsters. Additionally the knives have a chance to ricochet to nearby monsters.

zh.name: 刀刃之扇
zh.description: 攻击有概率向你周围掷出飞刀，对附近怪物造成物理伤害。飞刀还有概率弹射到附近怪物身上。

name: For Honor
description: Temporarily increases your attack damage and movement speed.

zh.name: 为了荣耀
zh.description: 临时提高你的攻击伤害和移动速度。

name: Omnislash
description: Become untargetable and rapidly strike monsters multiple times with increased attack rating dealing increased damage.

zh.name: 无双斩
zh.description: 进入无法被选中的状态，以更高的攻击命中快速多次斩击怪物，造成提高的伤害。

subskills.name: Omnislash
subskills.description: Core of the Omnislash subtree.

zh.name: 无双斩
zh.description: 无双斩 子树核心。

subskills.name: Clean Hits
subskills.description: Increases attack rating when using omnislash.

zh.name: Clean 命中
zh.description: 提高攻击命中使用无双斩。

subskills.name: Extra Cut
subskills.description: Increases the amount of slashes.

zh.name: 额外 Cut
zh.description: 提高 slashes 的数量。

subskills.name: No Hesitation
subskills.description: Reduces the cooldown of omnislash.

zh.name: Hesitation
zh.description: 降低 cooldown 之无双斩。

subskills.name: Powerful Slashes
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by omnislash.

zh.name: Powerful Slashes
zh.description: 提高造成的伤害无双斩。

subskills.name: Looming Cover
subskills.description: When cast inside a smoke bomb invulnerability lasts for a small duration after omnislash ends.

zh.name: Looming 覆盖
zh.description: 当施法 inside 烟雾弹 invulnerability 持续小型持续时间之后无双斩 ends。

subskills.name: Nail In The Coffin
subskills.description: Throw a piercing kunai at a nearby enemy with reduced damage each strike.

zh.name: Nail Coffin
zh.description: 投掷穿透苦无附近敌人使用降低伤害每个 strike。

subskills.name: Emperor's Orders
subskills.description: Striking monsters with Omnislash has a chance to cast empires slash.

zh.name: Emperor's Orders
zh.description: 打击怪物使用无双斩有概率施法帝国斩。

subskills.name: Killstrike
subskills.description: Increases critical chance with omnislash.

zh.name: Killstrike
zh.description: 提高暴击概率使用无双斩。

subskills.name: Thirst For Death
subskills.description: Chance to increase the amount of slashes depending on your critical strike chance.

zh.name: Thirst 死亡
zh.description: 概率提高数量之 slashes depending 你的暴击概率。

subskills.name: Cutting Machine
subskills.description: Increases critical strike damage dealt by omnislash.

zh.name: 切割 Machine
zh.description: 提高暴击伤害 dealt 无双斩。

subskills.name: Lucky Strikes
subskills.description: Omnislash now always procs all your striking effects on hit with halved amount of slashes and decreased damage. Omnislash cooldown is increased.

zh.name: Lucky 打击
zh.description: 无双斩 always 触发全部你的打击效果命中时使用 halved 数量之 slashes 与降低伤害。无双斩 cooldown 提高。

subskills.name: Rain Of Chaos
subskills.description: Each slash now drops a shadow meteor down from the sky dealing area of effect damage when landing.

zh.name: 骤雨之混沌
zh.description: 每个斩击落下暗影陨石术倒地从天空造成范围伤害落地时。

subskills.name: Poison Coated Daggers
subskills.description: Throw poison coated daggers around with each slash inflicting poisoned and dealing increased damage to poisoned targets.

zh.name: 毒素 Coated 匕首
zh.description: 投掷毒素 coated 匕首周围使用每个斩击施加中毒与造成提高伤害至中毒目标。

subskills.name: Thunder Slashes
subskills.description: Unleash chain lightning with each slash inflicting lightning break on hit.

zh.name: 雷霆 Slashes
zh.description: 释放连锁闪电使用每个斩击施加闪电击破命中时。

name: Burst of Speed
description: Gain increased movement speed for a short period after killing a monster.

zh.name: 极速迸发
zh.description: 击杀怪物后短时间内获得提高的移动速度。

name: Shadow Step
description: Step into the shadows, re-appearing at the target location dealing Arcane Damage to all nearby monsters.

zh.name: 暗影步
zh.description: 步入暗影，在目标位置重现，对所有附近怪物造成奥术伤害。

subskills.name: Shadow Step
subskills.description: Core of the Shadow Step subtree.

zh.name: 暗影步
zh.description: 暗影步 子树核心。

subskills.name: Traversal
subskills.description: Increases teleport distance.

zh.name: Traversal
zh.description: 提高teleport 距离。

subskills.name: Calm And Collected
subskills.description: Decreases the mana cost of shadow step.

zh.name: Calm 与 Collected
zh.description: 降低法力消耗之暗影步。

subskills.name: Groundshaker
subskills.description: Chance to stun monsters on hit.

zh.name: Groundshaker
zh.description: 命中时有概率眩晕怪物。

subskills.name: Improved Lethality
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to stunned enemies.

zh.name: Improved Lethality
zh.description: 提高对 眩晕目标 造成的伤害。

subskills.name: Shadow Ally
subskills.description: Chance on cast to summon shadow clones to mimic your shadow step on a nearby target.

zh.name: 暗影 Ally
zh.description: 施法时有概率召唤物暗影 clones 至 mimic 你的暗影步附近目标。

subskills.name: Stepping Stone
subskills.description: Stunning an enemy with shadow step has a chance to increase your damage & cast rate for a short period stacking up to eight times.

zh.name: 踏入岩石
zh.description: 眩晕敌人使用暗影步有概率提高你的伤害 & 施法速度短距期间叠加上至 eight 次。

subskills.name: Sonic Boom
subskills.description: Chance on cast to deal damage additional times upon arrival.

zh.name: Sonic 爆轰
zh.description: 施法时有概率造成伤害额外次 upon arrival。

subskills.name: Crushing Step
subskills.description: Inflict armor break on hit.

zh.name: 粉碎 Step
zh.description: 命中时施加护甲击破。

subskills.name: Planned Out
subskills.description: Increases cast rate when using shadow step.

zh.name: Planned Out
zh.description: 提高施法速度使用暗影步。

subskills.name: Speed Demon
subskills.description: Increases area of effect radius for a portion of your bonus movement speed.

zh.name: 速度恶魔
zh.description: 提高 effect radius for a portion of your bonus movement speed 的范围。

subskills.name: Daggerstorms
subskills.description: Additionally summons a storm of daggers from the sky on hit.

zh.name: Daggerstorms
zh.description: 另外召唤物风暴之匕首从天空命中时。

subskills.name: Bargain With Demons
subskills.description: When landing nearby corpses are consumed to unleash a shadow explosion dealing area of effect damage and inflict burning.

zh.name: Bargain 使用恶魔
zh.description: 落地时附近尸体消耗至释放暗影爆炸造成范围伤害与施加燃烧。

subskills.name: Vortex Step
subskills.description: Pull nearby monsters towards you unleashing bolts of shadow energy into all directions when landing dealing additional damage and stunning them.

zh.name: 漩涡 Step
zh.description: 牵引附近怪物朝向你释放电矢之暗影能量进入全部方向落地时造成额外伤害与眩晕它们。

subskills.name: Pulsating Shadows
subskills.description: Shadow step now pulsates additional times inflicting arcane break.

zh.name: Pulsating 暗影
zh.description: 暗影步 pulsates 额外次施加奥术击破。

name: Way of the Warrior
description: Increases your attack damage and magic skill damage.

zh.name: 战士之道
zh.description: 提高你的攻击伤害和魔法技能伤害。

name: Empires Slash
description: Perform an area of effect attack blinking a short distance and dealing physical damage to monsters in its path. Empire slash lowers Omnislashes cooldown when it strikes a monster.

zh.name: 帝国斩
zh.description: 进行一次范围攻击，短距闪现并对路径上的怪物造成物理伤害。帝国斩命中怪物时会降低无双斩的冷却。

subskills.name: Empires Slash
subskills.description: Core of the Empires Slash subtree.

zh.name: 帝国斩
zh.description: 帝国斩 子树核心。

subskills.name: Steel Cutter
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by empire´s slash.

zh.name: Steel 工
zh.description: 提高造成的伤害帝国的斩击。

subskills.name: Destructive Force
subskills.description: Increases the area of effect of empire´s slash.

zh.name: Destructive 力量
zh.description: 提高 effect of empire´s slash 的范围。

subskills.name: Mastering The Sword
subskills.description: Increases the attack speed of empire’s slash when wielding a 2-handed weapon.

zh.name: Mastering Sword
zh.description: 提高 empire’s slash when wielding a 2-handed weapon 的攻击速度。

subskills.name: On The Mark
subskills.description: Increases the attack rating when using empire´s slash.

zh.name: 印记
zh.description: 提高攻击命中使用帝国的斩击。

subskills.name: Emperor's Command
subskills.description: Executes monsters after a threshold.

zh.name: Emperor's Command
zh.description: 处决怪物之后阈值。

subskills.name: Piercing Backslash
subskills.description: Gain additional critical strike damage when using empire’s slash.

zh.name: 穿透 Backslash
zh.description: 获得额外暴击伤害使用帝国的斩击。

subskills.name: Slithering Blade
subskills.description: Gain additional critical strike chance when using empire’s slash.

zh.name: Slithering 利刃
zh.description: 获得额外暴击概率使用帝国的斩击。

subskills.name: Absorb Life
subskills.description: Increases life steal when using empire´s slash.

zh.name: 吸收生命
zh.description: 提高生命偷取使用帝国的斩击。

subskills.name: Wounding Slash
subskills.description: Chance to inflict bleed on hit.

zh.name: 致伤斩击
zh.description: 命中时有概率施加流血。

subskills.name: Time To Spare
subskills.description: Increases the blink range.

zh.name: 时间至 Spare
zh.description: 提高blink 范围。

subskills.name: Unbridled Rage
subskills.description: Perform a series of slashes in multiple directions after teleporting.

zh.name: Unbridled 怒气
zh.description: 执行 series 之 slashes 多个方向之后传送。

subskills.name: Bloodcovered Edge
subskills.description: Monsters hit by empire´s slash rebound an additional empire´s slash towards a nearby monster. Empire´s slash now has a cooldown.

zh.name: Bloodcovered 锋刃
zh.description: 怪物命中帝国的斩击弹射额外帝国的斩击朝向附近怪物。帝国的斩击有 cooldown。

subskills.name: Cone Of Death
subskills.description: Empire slash no longer teleports and attacks with multiple smaller slashes in a cone infront of you.

zh.name: 锥形之死亡
zh.description: 帝国斩击更久传送与攻击使用多个更小 slashes 锥形 infront 之你。

subskills.name: Muda Muda Muda Muda Muda
subskills.description: Perform a huge attack covering the whole screen dealing high damage. Empire´s slash no longer teleports you and now has a cooldown.

zh.name: Muda Muda Muda Muda Muda
zh.description: 执行巨大攻击覆盖 whole screen 造成高伤害。帝国的斩击更久传送你与有 cooldown。
